# Pillow Bud distributions

These are built distribution packages generated by GitHub Actions.
Select the package matching your operating system and CPU architecture.

- Android: APK
- Windows: EXE installer and/or portable ZIP
- macOS: DMG (Intel x64 or Apple Silicon ARM64)
- Linux: AppImage and Debian package

Android builds may use CI debug signing if the managed release keystore
is not configured. Such APKs are for testing, not production release.

Build source: https://github.com/Harry-Jees/Pillow_Bud/actions
